main_measure.name: mean excess 2-bar return of the cases over the coin's mean 2-bar return, before costs

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope > 0 with t >= 2); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 or slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of the case's excess 2-bar return on its forecast

decided_by: Inconclusive rule: neither the confirm nor the reject rule is met, a t lies between -2 and 2 on a measure (t mean 0.51, t slope 0.33).
reading: Bets are read as in the holding-period rule (forecast rise >= 2 from its lowest level on its side since the last bet), one per 2-bar grid cell from each window's first row taking the cell's first bet bar and its return from that bar's close over 2 bars inside the window; the drift is the coin's mean of grid 2-bar returns over all its windows; the mean's t sums deviations per day (cluster SE with D/(D-1)); the slope is ordinary OLS on the case's forecast; the 30 minimum counts case-days.
